# What It Really Takes to Get 51,000 Employees Using AI

Jessica Hendrix ran the rollout at CHRISTUS Health - 51,000 associates, about 20 core systems, a year of security review before anything went live. She walks through what it took and where it got hard.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/icons/clockCountdown_dark.svg)30 mins

## What you'll walk away with

Their chief human resources officer said what a lot of boards are saying now: do something with AI. Today Noah - their name for Leena AI - is live at CHRISTUS. This is the honest version of what happened in between.- "Where do we even start?" - the two words CHRISTUS built everything around
- "Build it or buy it?" - why building it themselves was never on the table
- "Will security sign off?" - a year of review, and the one hard limit
- "Is our content even ready?" - duplicate policies, dead links, no governance
- "What if nobody uses it?" - roadshows, a game called Stump Noah, and new hires
- "How do I know it's working?" - the signal she watches, not the slide stat
